description: Expressive starter transition: directional translate, scale, rotate, motion blur, and fade, all sharing one eased progress curve for cross-cut continuity. Optionally pivots scale/rotate around a carried asset's position via carryAssetId.

direction.description: Shared travel vector: exiting scene moves along it, incoming scene arrives from the opposite side

scale.description: 'far' scale both sides pass through; <1 = recede/depth, >1 = push-forward zoom, 1 = no scale change

rotateDeg.description: Degrees of continuous spin across the cut (signed; exiting 0->rotateDeg, entering -rotateDeg->0)

blurPx.description: Peak motion-blur radius at the transition's midpoint

fade.description: Whether opacity animates alongside the other axes

curve.description: Cubic-bezier [x1,y1,x2,y2] shaping progress; ignored when overshoot is true

overshoot.description: Swap in a back-ease pair (anticipation on exit, overshoot-then-settle on entry) for a springier feel

anchorOrigin.description: CSS transform-origin used when no carryAssetId pivot is available

carryAssetId.description: Optional asset id present in both outgoing and incoming scene; when set, scale/rotate pivot around that asset's resolved position on each side instead of anchorOrigin
